versions.changelog:
Version 1.2.4

- No file changes detected in this release.
- No new features, fixes, or updates introduced.

Initial release of cn-lorem-ipsum:

- Generates random words, sentences, and paragraphs via command line.
- Supports customizable output count, minimum/maximum word counts per item, and reproducible results with a seed.
- Offers both Chinese and English placeholder text options.
- Built using only the Python standard library with secure random generation by default.
